$comment: Channel-owned, extensible list -- validates against design-system/schemas/src/post-archetype.schema.json, one entry per element. NOT a closed global enum; only the archetype(s) actually exercised so far are listed here.

archetypes.label: Product Promotion
archetypes.description: Promotes a specific Kaduse product (e.g. a stethoscope) directly -- distinct from a comparison, a news/announcement post, or an important-day post. User-approved 2026-09-04 (Batch K2A). Detailed subtype/content rules live in channels/kaduse-medikal/content/policies/product-promotion.json, not in this registry entry -- this schema has no field for approval status or subtypes, so approval is recorded in the policy file instead.

archetypes.label: Product Comparison
archetypes.description: Objectively compares exactly two different Ana Seri (series) product families using authoritative catalog facts -- distinct from Product Promotion's same-series variant showcase. User-approved 2026-09-04 (Batch K2A). Detailed cardinality/content rules live in channels/kaduse-medikal/content/policies/product-comparison.json.

archetypes.label: Research / Scientific Research
archetypes.description: Presents and explains a specific published study (study-centric: what did the study examine and find) -- distinct from Kaduse News (event/development-centric: what happened). Supersedes the earlier candidate label 'Clinical Evidence / Research Summary', which is not a separate active canonical archetype. User-approved 2026-09-04 (Batch K2B). Note (Batch N1): the boundary partner's name changed from the earlier 'Medical News' working label to the canonical 'Kaduse News' (id: kaduse-news) -- this archetype's own approved semantics are unchanged. Detailed content-structure/evidence rules live in channels/kaduse-medikal/content/policies/research.json.

archetypes.label: Kaduse News
archetypes.description: Covers both external medical/healthcare/industry news (e.g. WHO/FDA/EMA developments, Turkish health-policy news, medical-device regulation) and Kaduse/company-specific news (new product arrival, company announcement, event/fair participation, partnership, store/company development) -- event/development-centric: what happened. Distinct from Research (study/paper-centric). Supersedes any earlier assumption that a separate top-level 'Medical News' archetype would exist alongside Kaduse News -- that model is retired; Medical News is a subset of Kaduse News, not a sibling archetype. User-approved 2026-09-04 (Batch N1). Detailed content rules live in channels/kaduse-medikal/content/policies/kaduse-news.json; source pack (placeholder, empty) at channels/kaduse-medikal/content/news-sources.json.

archetypes.label: Clinical Education / Auscultation Education
archetypes.description: STRICTLY stethoscope-related technical education only (how to use a stethoscope, bell vs diaphragm, cardiac/lung auscultation technique, sound-category identification, Korotkoff sound technique, digital stethoscope operation, cleaning/maintenance, common auscultation mistakes) -- NEVER diagnosis, treatment, medication, referral, or general disease education with no direct stethoscope connection. Evergreen/editorially-planned, not calendar-triggered (typical triggerType: EVERGREEN_TOPIC or CONTENT_PLANNER). Every technical claim must be backed by a verified source from the dedicated Clinical Education source registry (channel-content-os mcp-server/src/clinical-education/source-registry.ts) -- never the News or Observance registries, never LLM memory. User-approved 2026-09-04 (Batch CE1). Topic registry: channels/kaduse-medikal/content/clinical-education-topics.json.
